def parse_ts(df):
    return df.withColumn("ts", coalesce(
        F.expr("try_to_timestamp(substring(TRANSACTION_TIMESTAMP, 1, 18), 'dd-MMM-yy HH.mm.ss')"),
        F.expr("try_to_timestamp(substring(TRANSACTION_TIMESTAMP, 1, 17), 'dd-MMM-yy HH.mm.s')")
    ))

df_ts = parse_ts(df)

    df_ts.filter(
        (col("TRANSACTION_TYPE") == "Loan Payment Via API") &
        (col("DEBIT_PARTY_ID") == LENDER_ID) &
        (col("CREDIT_PARTY_TYPE") == "Customer")
    )
    .withColumnRenamed("CREDIT_PARTY_ID", "user_id")
    .select("user_id", col("ts").alias("loan_ts"))
)

# First repayment per user (principal or interest)
first_repayment = (
    df_ts.filter(
        col("TRANSACTION_TYPE").isin([
            "Loan Principal Collection via API",
            "Loan Interest via API"
        ]) &
        (col("DEBIT_PARTY_TYPE") == "Customer")
    )
    .withColumnRenamed("DEBIT_PARTY_ID", "user_id")
    .groupBy("user_id")
    .agg(spark_min("ts").alias("first_repay_ts"))
)

# First penalty per user
first_penalty = (
    df_ts.filter(
        (col("TRANSACTION_TYPE") == "Loan Penalty via API") &
        (col("DEBIT_PARTY_TYPE") == "Customer")
    )
    .withColumnRenamed("DEBIT_PARTY_ID", "user_id")
    .groupBy("user_id")
    .agg(spark_min("ts").alias("first_penalty_ts"))
)

    index_loan
    .join(first_repayment, on="user_id", how="left")
    .join(first_penalty,   on="user_id", how="left")
    .withColumn("days_to_repay",   datediff(col("first_repay_ts"),  col("first_loan_ts")))

)

).display(truncate=False)
